rationale: Ula is bringing embodied AI robotics to market as a founding GTM & Ops lead, while Rid has hands-on experience building AI-powered robotics systems and multi-agent infrastructure at Rutgers and Accenture. Rid's technical depth in ML, robotics, and agent coordination (Python, C++, TypeScript) could inform product strategy and market fit, while Ula's go-to-market perspective and operational experience navigating the robotics space would be valuable for Rid's applied research trajectory.
intro_message: Ula, meet Rid — you're both working on AI robotics from different angles (Ula on commercialization, Rid on the ML systems layer), and could swap insights on what actually works in embodied AI.
